about.title: About Lawns & Sprinklers USA
text: Headquartered in Seabrook, Texas and serving the Greater Houston/Bay Area, Lawns & Sprinklers USA, LLC, is a family-owned and operated business serving commercial, industrial, and residential customers with landscaping and irrigation.

An experienced landscaping and irrigation business, we have the knowledge and expertise to handle projects of all sizes, from commercial and industrial sites to residential properties. We are committed to providing exceptional service to keep your outdoor property in tip-top shape.
We know you have a choice in who you choose for landscaping, irrigation, and lawncare.
